name: TOC Co., Ltd.
summary: TOC Co., Ltd. engages in the real estate business in Japan. It operates through the Real Estate Business and the Linen Supply and Laundry Business segments. The company is involved in the leasing, management, and operation of rental showrooms, exhibition halls, conference rooms, and parking lots; rental and cleaning of various textile products such as yukata and sheets, as well as hotel, restaurant, and sports linens; and provision of laundry services.
